whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Jai Mahavir Dental Hospital,

I noticed your dental hospital has strong 4.7★ reviews in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for patient appointment bookings.

Maine aapke hospital ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, dental services menu, aur emergency contact integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/mahavir

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Jai Mahavir Dental Hospital team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke hospital ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp appointment booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your dental care services near Jamal Road in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
